title.narrative: UNESCO Creative Cities Network Programme 43 C/5

description.narrative: The UNESCO Creative Cities Network (UCCN) is an expanding international city network, with a growing potential to innovate on culture driven urban development. Its member cities have developed and experimented innovative ways to integrate culture and creativity at the core of their policies, strategies and plans, which significantly contributes to sustainable development. As a UNESCO flagship city programme, the Network has contributed to strengthening advocacy efforts towards the integration of culture in the international sustainable development agenda. With its 408 member cities in more than 100 countries, the Network has a growing voice in international discussions on cities and sustainable urban development. As a result, the number of cities applying to each Call for Application has also been rising. The Network covers a variety of cities, from small-sized settlements to metropolises, within various economic, social, political and environmental settings. This urban diversity allows the emergence of a wide range of policies, strategies and practices at the city level aimed at dealing with common challenges of our time.
